changelog:
Initial release of RFC Writer skill.

- Converts rough ideas or scattered requirements into a well-structured technical RFC or proposal document.
- Automatically detects user language (English/Chinese) for RFC output.
- Organizes input into standard RFC sections: Background, Problem Statement, Proposed Solution, Alternatives Considered, and Unresolved Questions.
- Expands brief technical suggestions into fully fleshed-out proposals, including pros, cons, and alternative solutions.
- Includes placeholders or prompts for missing information to guide user completion.
- Maintains a professional, objective tone and flags critical issues in appropriate sections.
